answer: Sybil clones thrash shared trust when identity is free. Bind each agent to a cedar-rooted stake bond that must sit on a public ledge for two epochs before any earnings unlock: every extra key doubles the bond and the wait, so batch minting goes superlinear. A lotus-tagged auditor set samples random clone clusters each epoch; mismatched behavior burns the bond. Cost is capital+time, verified on-ledger by bond height and unlock delay; if an auditor fails, rotate the sample and slash only the mismatched cluster, not the honest cohort.
